form:FormGroup.label: Id
form:FormGroup.helpText: Unique ID of this component on the dashboard, generated when the component is added (e.g. embedded-query-AB1C2). It cannot be changed.

form:FormGroup.label: Name
form:FormGroup.helpText: Name of this component, shown in its tab on the dashboard.
Runs a saved Query document, chosen in Referenced Query, so changes to that query appear here. Untick to keep a copy of a query inside the dashboard instead. Default is ticked.

form:FormGroup.label: Referenced Query
form:FormGroup.helpText: The Query document this component runs when Reference Existing Query is ticked. You need Use permission on the query.
Runs the query automatically when the dashboard is opened. When not ticked, results appear only after you run the query. Default is not ticked.
Re-runs the query regularly while the dashboard is open, waiting Refresh Interval after each run finishes. The first run still needs Query On Open or a manual run. Default is not ticked.

form:FormGroup.label: Refresh Interval
form:FormGroup.helpText: How often the query is re-run when Auto Refresh is ticked. Enter a number with a unit of ms, s, m, h or d (e.g. 30s or 5m); a number with no unit is in milliseconds. The minimum is 10 seconds. Default is 10s.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Number with unit, e.g. 30s or 5m. Minimum 10 seconds.

form:FormGroup.label: Table Page Size
form:FormGroup.helpText: Number of rows shown on each page of the query results table, from 1 to 10,000. Default is 100.
